# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and WASM expansion** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 brings Skia m151, significant hot-path performance gains, and WASM .NET 11 support. Multiple P/Invoke round-trips are replaced with managed arithmetic across colour conversion, premultiplication, and shaper paths. WASM gains Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11 and the new exnref exception-handling model. A CPU raster regression from m151 is also fixed.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m151 engine** — The bundled Skia engine advances to m151, with three rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs included. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **CPU raster regression fixed** — SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT was restored to prevent a CPU image-sampling performance regression introduced in the initial m151 integration. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing and ReadOnlySpan overloads** — SKColor hex parsing is optimized and new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads are added, reducing allocations in colour-parsing hot paths. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — A native resource was leaked when FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) failed to decode; it is now correctly released. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Unnecessary unsafe modifier removed from GRContextOptions** — The unsafe modifier on GRContextOptions was unnecessary and has been removed, keeping the public API surface clean. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions ported to managed** — SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply are now pure managed integer arithmetic, eliminating P/Invoke overhead on these hot paths. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **HarfBuzzSharp hot-path allocations eliminated** — Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free using a pooled encoder, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse no longer allocates a per-call char[4]. These are high-frequency paths in text-shaping workloads. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))
- **SKShaper glyph results read via zero-copy spans** — SKShaper now reads glyph output via zero-copy spans instead of copying arrays, reducing GC pressure in text layout. ([#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **SKFourByteTag.Parse allocation removed** — The per-call char[4] allocation in SKFourByteTag.Parse is eliminated, benefiting callers that parse font tables in a loop. ([#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))

## Platform

- **WASM: Emscripten 5.0.6 and .NET 11 support** — Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 are added, built with the new exnref exception-handling model. A preview-.NET WASM test job validates exception-handling compatibility on each PR. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with allocation-free AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse paths, reducing GC pressure in text-shaping workloads.
